blocks.text: Balcony with a bar counter and grill

parts.html: Even a small balcony can have a place to relax. An example from one of our projects: 8 square meters fit a corner sofa, a bar counter, a cabinet, and a barbecue.
Lounge area: A corner sofa with cushions and throws runs along two walls.
Bar counter: A wood-and-metal counter with high stools runs along the glazing. This is where morning coffee is had, looking out over the city.

Storage: A roomy cabinet looks as if it were built into the wall, which is an optical trick. Inside are seasonal items, cushions, throws, and tools, and the plain fronts keep the small space from looking cluttered.
Barbecue: The compact grill stands on its own base rather than on the furniture, which is safer and makes cooking easier.
UFO heater: It lets the balcony be used all year round: even in the colder months, you can spend an evening out here with family or friends.
Greenery and decor: Plants in planters, with climbers winding along the beams. In the evening, floor lamps and built-in lights come on and give a soft, diffused light.
The balcony has become one more room: people have coffee here, grill, and get together with friends, while seasonal items are stored in the cabinet instead of taking up space in the apartment.

You can talk through a balcony or loggia at a free consultation at the DUMSKAYA DESIGN studio in Bratislava. We can make cabinets and other built-in furniture for the balcony in our own workshop. The studio has more than 15 years of experience.
